name: db-stack
description: AgentiX-E database stack — cluster (Raft consensus), federation (cross-cluster sync) and operations (ops framework) as a single monorepo

scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-stack-e2e run test:harness && pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-stack-e2e run test:cluster && pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-stack-e2e run test:engine && pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-stack-e2e run test:federation
scripts.verify: pnpm check:gates && pnpm check:english && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm coverage:all && pnpm coverage:gate && pnpm e2e
scripts.test:load: pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-cluster run test:load && pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-federation run test:perf
scripts.test:perf: pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-cluster run test:perf && pnpm --filter @agentix-e/db-stack-e2e run bench

allow.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs; reaches the tree only through vitest/stryker/vite (dev), whose glob input is this repository's own paths — no patched version has been published (patched: <0.0.0)
